title: Authority and confidentiality review
html:
Authority and confidentiality review

Identify the appropriate principle for each proposed research or disclosure decision.

Required responses

metadata.taxLawPeriod: 2026; exercise-specific rates and limits are stated in each case

fields.label: Research response to the blog conflict

options.value: Apply and analyze the controlling authority
options.label: Apply and analyze the controlling authority

options.value: Let the client choose the law
options.label: Let the client choose the law

fields.correct: Apply and analyze the controlling authority
fields.explanation: Informal summaries do not override controlling law.

fields.label: Privilege explanation

options.value: Protection is limited and depends on the applicable law
options.label: Protection is limited and depends on the applicable law

fields.correct: Protection is limited and depends on the applicable law
fields.explanation: Privilege and confidentiality have defined, different scopes.

fields.label: Response to the lender

options.value: Evaluate consent and applicable disclosure rules
options.label: Evaluate consent and applicable disclosure rules

fields.correct: Evaluate consent and applicable disclosure rules
fields.explanation: Disclosure must be permitted under the applicable duties and rules.

fields.label: Court-decision research step

options.value: Check jurisdiction, facts, and subsequent developments
options.label: Check jurisdiction, facts, and subsequent developments

fields.correct: Check jurisdiction, facts, and subsequent developments
fields.explanation: A decision’s relevance and precedential value require context.

exhibits.title: File notes
exhibits.html: A staff member chooses a blog over a controlling statute. A client calls all CPA communications privileged. A lender asks for a return without consent. A manager relies on a court decision without checking jurisdiction or later law.

exhibits.title: Required approach
exhibits.html: Use applicable authority, distinguish legal protections, and evaluate permitted disclosures.
